required_reporting: Retain raw/derived old fields, describe their source-defined phase. A zero sampled U occupancy does not establish zero pending WB or zero WB latency. Use same-mode across conditions and separately source-defined WAD lifetime/pressure/drain evidence.
staged_max: max m_ft_wb record count at send_write_request bind, distinct sampled object/phase from occupiedWB slots
staging_lifetime: B start resets at actual victim readout/copy phase0; U start resets at actual producer commit. Both end at lowerFIFO push/accept, before actual DRAM set_done. Cross-mode total/average is not an identically bounded WAD lifetime.
wb_occupancy_sum: sum of occupied physical slots with allocation_roleWB sampled after baseline_cache::cycle lower drain; both organizations dynamically transfer slots into WB role. It is not dedicated-WBUF-only, not event-record peak or common continuous residence integral.
